home.hero_desc: Production-ready Playwright + Claude toolkit: self-healing tests, edge-case data generation, and automated bug triage. OpenHuman-style UI, zero lock-in.
home.mock_mode_note: All demos run in MOCK mode by default — no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY needed.
home.optional_key: Optional: set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env to use live Claude calls.
home.feature_healing_desc: AI suggests new locators when your UI changes — no more brittle selectors.
home.feature_datagen_desc: Generates SQLi, XSS, nulls, RTL text and boundary payloads automatically.
home.feature_triage_desc: Reads error logs and writes Jira-ready bug reports with root-cause analysis.
home.feature_claude_desc: Every agent and skill is powered by Anthropic Claude. MOCK mode requires no API key.
home.feature_missions_desc: Gamified QA challenges that change every day. Earn XP, build streaks, sharpen your skills.
home.mission_desc: QA automation tooling should be accessible to every engineer, not just big teams with expensive tooling.
home.mission_p1: Democratize AI-assisted QA for every engineer
home.mission_p2: 100% open-source — fork it, extend it, run it locally
home.mission_p3: Community-first: every feature started as a GitHub Issue
home.mission_p4: Zero vendor lock-in: MOCK mode works with no API key
home.contribute_subtitle: open-qa lives and grows through community contributions.
home.contribute_issues_desc: Report bugs, request features, share feedback
home.contribute_discussions_desc: Ask questions, propose ideas, connect with others
home.contribute_prs_desc: Submit fixes, add agents, improve the UI
